SELECT q.*, GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT c.course_name ORDER BY c.id SEPARATOR '、') course_names, GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT CONCAT(c.course_name,' / ',qc.stage_name) ORDER BY c.id SEPARATOR '、') course_stage_names FROM exam_question q LEFT JOIN exam_question_course qc ON qc.question_id=q.id LEFT JOIN sys_course c ON c.id=qc.course_id
AND q.question_type=#{questionType} AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM exam_question_course x WHERE x.question_id=q.id AND x.course_id=#{courseId}) AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM exam_question_course x WHERE x.question_id=q.id AND x.course_id=#{courseId} AND x.stage_name=#{stageName}) AND q.difficulty=#{difficulty} AND q.status=#{status} AND (q.question_content LIKE CONCAT('%',#{keyword},'%') OR q.answer_content LIKE CONCAT('%',#{keyword},'%') OR q.analysis_content LIKE CONCAT('%',#{keyword},'%'))
GROUP BY q.id ORDER BY q.id DESC
SELECT id,question_id,option_key,option_content FROM exam_question_option WHERE question_id=#{questionId} ORDER BY sort_order,id
SELECT qc.course_id,c.course_name,qc.stage_name FROM exam_question_course qc JOIN sys_course c ON c.id=qc.course_id WHERE qc.question_id=#{questionId} ORDER BY qc.course_id
mapper.update: UPDATE exam_question SET status=#{status},updated_at=NOW() WHERE id=#{id}
